data: What is the accuracy of the 'Klementiev et al.' method when the number of documents in the training set is 1000?

The question asks for the accuracy of the 'Klementiev et al.' method when the number of documents in the training set is 1000. From the caption, we can see that the figure shows cross-lingual classification accuracy results for DE→EN. The legend indicates three methods: MT, Klementiev et al., and CorrNet. The green line represents the 'Klementiev et al.' method. By examining the graph, we can see that at the point where the number of documents in the training set is 1000, the green line (representing the 'Klementiev et al.' method) is approximately at 72%. Therefore, the accuracy of the 'Klementiev et al.' method when the number of documents in the training set is 1000 is around 72%.
